content: 5:1-20 Yisas munon ger aibigau wot igama qanganget igoar eng musiarei
Sani-sani aib di ya bures arir igoar eng ende taisia waga ne bo Galili ya tai eng purab bo Gerasa wurinou ai end isumirei.
End isub qamb ne tabin ya tai end wogub daan irab gamir eng munon ger ai bigau misir ba songesia qenen munon teteret end igoar eng Yisas end iroa gab dererei.
Munon eng ai bigau ba songesia ne qer gagam boru, munon ger maigas pi is me baab bunomt touri igamau.
Qen qei-qei baab touri igour eng wo qenen bunom eng ombopur ne ain quran aib-aib eng gor ar nogotoat igoai. Ende aba ne munon ger pi isub me baab igamau.
Itum woromt eng wo qenen munon teteret ai qaur end qas igo ne nomon ba wonomi waramb aimot ab eab ende at igoai.
Qenen ende at igama ne qen end Yisas end is igama ne munon eng wo mugen asi gab ne uyab-uyab Yisas menmant wes end yar gamaur wat bugab ne aimot simot eab qamar:
“Yisas ne Qenu mi gugum wuritanamimar eng wonou wau eng ne. End ne ye mai yesieriban? Ye Qenu unumot net quraum, ne ye me yesumungasi,” ende qamarei.
Munon eng qamar eng Yisas wo ai bigau misir ba songesiamir eng wurit qamar: “An munon e wogub der iuar,” ende qamarei.
Qamara ne Yisas wo der munon eng nob qamar: “Ne unum your?” Ende qamara ne munon eng der qamar: “Ai bigau irou yoopuri igour end ne ye unum eng Ami.”
Ende qamara ne ai bigau munon end miteri qamb igour eng Yisast simot ab qamamir: “Ininou toar arirama munon e wogub ar ai qorut et me isunei.
Ne inimurima in bur yurau aib ger iro igour end wurit isun eng uber qiyo,” ende qamarari ne

Yisas “Io” qamb ne ai bigau eng wuriimurima bur yurau aib eng wurit isari ne bur qanganget iua ai yaru aib eng der isi ya tumun aib erobon isub ya nub umb uburemirei. Buru yurau aib eng gugum 2,000-ende.
Bur eng ende yag isub ya nub umb uburari ne munon bur oroar igour eng ende gab ne iua is munon ginam aibt igour eng ne ginam qei qani-qani eng wurinob qamarari mi eng ebeter eng gub qamb yaremirei.
Yarab munon qoan qanganget ab toaubig igama igub igour eng di gamir eng bo misir igub mingoan qumani wogub qi Yisas nob igama di gamirei. Gab borusi mom yariamirei.
Ne munon qei Yisas mi eng aba gamir eng qei wurinob qamarari imbigumirei.
Imbig ne der Yisas inwogub iua qamb qebiamirei.
Ende qebi qamarari ne wo qoaib qamb tabint isa ne munon musuor eng nob isib qamb qamarei.
Qamara Yisas nob qamar: “Me yenob isinenei, ne nonou ginamt isub munon aib netoubet nemusia git uput yaran eng gab bainori tainmagrori wurinob qamara igunor,” ende qamb wogub isumirei.
Ne munon eng der wonou ginamt me iroau, wo der munai ginam 10-end isub Yisas musuor end wurinob qamara igub qiet mismisiramirei.
5:21-43 Yairus waibou nob yamangar ger Yisas mi goan taut baar eng
Yisas munon eng ende musub wogub bo sarau qei ebeib ater eng imurimari wogub bo tabint isub yonam di ig isorei. Isari munon yurau aib bo end qiumuniamirei.

Ende qiumuni igamari ne munon baraitari ger unum Yairus. Yairus wo inorou munai qoat igoai. Wo diab Yisas gab menmant end wonomi ariramau gas ende at inab simot eab qamar: “Yonou yamangar wau sig mom mumun gab diab quraum. Barai, mai yarab uben benerimata toar mai diereminer qamb ar quraum.”
Ende qamara Yisas nob isorei. Isa munon yurau aib nob isub wo mom opur wagomirei.
Ne qataben isub igo yamangar ger qenen amug isub qib igama togun 12-ende warei.

Ende igama ne toar munon wuri musub igour eng qei der amug isub igoar eng boopur weginer qamb qenen musub igurei. Toar puriani eng ende nub uter gab qiyo munon qei ar musiari end nomon qur taui wurisab ende ebet borusi qumundigir quguraget wegib qamb misir igor eng wonou git goan end misir igub qigimiet at qib igoai. Ende at qib igoar eng amug isub igoar eng me boopur wagau, wonou ar ten ende igoai.

Qenen ende at qib outet igoar end Yisas mi eng gagar at qib igoar eng qob toau igub diab ete misir igor: “Ye mingoan gabut end qas bine toar eng weginer.” Ende qamb ne munon yurau aib wuribar isub Yisas mingoan gabut end baab gar eng amug isub igoar eng boopur wagerei.
Yamangar eng mingoant bea ne Yisas wo qiribiten sarau baab igoar eng bo meinet bibinat igub ne igeser munon yurau aib eng wurinob qamar: “Your ye mingoan qotarai?”
Ende qamara ne wonou munon yurau wuriimbig qib igoar eng der nob qamamir: “Maia, nonou gari et qib igo qobia? Munon yurau aib noopur igo noatrour, meimet qamb your yoatra qamb igoan?”
Ende qamarari ne Yisas me wagau, munon qotar eng mom gab wegib qamb asi qib igoai.
Ende at qib igama ne yamangar eng qesi wara wogub diab Yisas menmant end gamaur wat bugab ne wo mi ebeter eng gugum Yisast mom dibes qamb ugarei.
Ende qamara Yisas igub wogub ne yamangar eng nob qamar: “Ne yet oau apand burab yebea toar ne wagar eng gab ne isub oau uberet qib igoar,” ende nob qamarei.
Yisas yamangar eng nob ende qamb igama ne munon qei Yairus nob igour eng diab nob qamamir: “Ne wau qoan umai, meimet qamb bo sabar imbigau munon mot isib qamb at igoan?”
Ende qamarari ne Yisas wuri qob qamamir eng me igau. Wo der Yairus nob qamar: “Nonou wau umar end sig me toubei, oau gari apand burab igoar,” ende nob qamarei.
Ende qamb wogub nob isib qamb ne munon qebebi me oromar isau. Pita Yems ne Yems wonou umour Yon ende gari oromar nob isumirei.
Isi yarab Yairus wonou munait end is igumir e munon yamangar eab toau big igurei.
Ende at igamari ne Yisas mor isub wurinob qamar: “Meimet qamb toau big yeiser igoumon? Wau e segagam me umau, ar naat inai igo.”

Ende qamara wogub ne munon eng gagar der borusi tai-tai igerig igurei. Ende abari ne wo der munon gugum wuriimurima ag isub uburari ne wau umor wonou ur unor ne wonou imbigau munon omburgari ende oromar mon tumbigi end isumirei.
Isub ne Yisas wau umor uben end baab ne qamar: “Talita Kum” Qob eng qanam eng ete: yamangar wau nemeni igoum. Der bugom.”
Ende qamara ne wau eng qand der bugab naget-naget isorei. Yamangar wau eng togun 12-ende. Isa gab qiet ne qesi igara gab igurei.
Ende aba ne Yisas der qoronob wuritaisi qamar: “An ye mi e oboum eng an qob ar-ar me qamb qib igoarar.” Ende qamb ne yamangar wau end qamar: “Mi utari niner,” ende qamarei.
